verdict.rationale: The pack contains no explicit no-training policy or training opt-out for the hosted service. It does document a self-hosted option where the engine, embeddings and LLM run locally and 'your data never leaves the building', which effectively keeps data away from vendor model training. It also documents per-container deletion via the API or console. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that customer data is not used for model training, a training opt-out control on the hosted platform, and independent corroboration.
